maximum_depth_rule: All 676 Phase 9 Reviewed Hyogo statements remain raw maximum-depth records until current values, annual results, targets, definitions, and annotations can be separated through reviewed field-level mappings.
history_boundary: The four registered documents and all strategy, indicator, measure, baseline, target, and period expressions remain distinct source context. Similar wording is not treated as one time series, and no annual result is attached automatically.
non_goals: Do not infer annual actual and future target fields from mixed raw statements.
Do not merge similar indicators, strategy layers, document versions, or source rows.
Do not replace missing units, periods, populations, or aggregation boundaries.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
